issueRegistry.title: Space reopens the focused minimap after closing the map instead of starting flight
issueRegistry.confidence: high; incidental case plus controlled repeat and scene-click flight positive control
reproductionSteps: From a stopped grounded car with2.5s flight charge, click Minimap.
Click actual Close map; driving HUD returns with focus on Minimap.
Press Space once; City map reopens.
Close again; car remains grounded at0km/h and boost remains2.5s.
issueRegistry.expected: The advertised Space flight shortcut should work after returning to driving, without an extra scene click; preserve accessible keyboard behavior while resolving the conflict.
issueRegistry.actual: Minimap focus intercepts Space and opens the map. The Close button itself dismisses the map. No concurrent flight or charge depletion observed.
issueRegistry.incidentalCase: Earlier M/zoom/Close/Space sequence also reopened the map; charge stayed10.0s.
issueRegistry.workaround: Click the visible driving scene before pressing Space; this produced actual flight in the same pass.
issueRegistry.sourceFinding: DialogFocus.hide restores earlier focus or minimap. The focused minimap Space handler prevents default, stops propagation and opens the map before the window flight handler.
issueRegistry.deduplication: Related to PT-009 focus handling, but distinct from that repaired issue: this happens after map dismissal, rather than focus escaping while the map is open.
issueRegistry.nextStep: Retain explicit keyboard opener focus and repeat phone hardware checks during future coverage.
issueRegistry.fixSummary: Pointer/M map closure returns scene focus; explicit keyboard opener retains focus. Pointer/Close/Space observed actual flight; offline Game.start tests cover both focus modes.
